messages:
Leah (CSM): Heads-up — Sable dedicated pool bring-up dry-run scheduled WED 08:45 PT. Goal: verify quota bump, autoscale behaviour, and measure token economics. Renewal touchpoint in 6 weeks so we want clean perf signals + enablement notes. Who can lead the dry-run?
Nate (Solutions Eng): I can run the generator + collect traces. What quota are we provisioning?
Sam (Infra): Propose 150 reserved units for the dry-run window 08:45-09:30 PT. Autoscale shadow enabled to 160% of baseline.
Leah (CSM): 150 OK. Customer flagged a 20% token burn increase on their sandbox last week — capture before/after costs.
Priya (Oncall): I'll be oncall. Plan a 5m canary at 08:50 before the ramp. If error rate > 0.8% for two consecutive 1m windows, we abort and fallback to the smaller variant.
Nate (Solutions Eng): Dry-run plan: 08:45 smoke -> 08:50 canary (15 rps) -> 08:55 ramp to 220 rps over 20m -> 09:20 short soak -> 09:28 drain. I'll push traffic script to /runs/sable/dryrun/.
Nate (Solutions Eng): Wrk command for the run:
```
wrk -t6 -c120 -d00:20:00 http://staging.redwood/v1/generate -s sable_scenarios.lua
```
Leah (CSM): Please include the customers top 3 prompt templates in the script and enable KV prefix reuse. Also add a short quality check: sample 50 responses and run basic fuzz diff vs prod baseline.
Sam (Infra): Ops tweaks: enable `int8_quant=true` on the staging model to test cost delta. Note: quality delta may be visible, flag for research. We'll also collect token counts and billing metrics.
Priya (Oncall): Rollback checklist (short): 1) Stop load job 2) Scale pool to baseline (40 units) 3) Disable quant flag 4) Disable cache toggle 5) Re-route traffic to stable model 6) Open bridge if abnormal errors persist.
Nate (Solutions Eng): Quick post-run validations to run after soak:
```
# pool state
curl -s https://staging.redwood/api/pools/sable | jq '{units,healthy,p99}'
# telemetry sample
curl -s https://telemetry.redwood/api/metrics?suite=sable | jq '.token_usage,.error_rate'
```
Leah (CSM): I'll send a short enablement survey to the customer after the run to capture feelings about latency, result quality, and cost sensitivity: https://forms.gle/sable-run-feedback (short, 5 q). We'll mark renewal flags if they report quality regressions or >15% unexpected cost.
Sam (Infra): Note: Kube node maintenance is scheduled at 07:00 PT earlier that day — nothing in conflict but leaving note.
Priya (Oncall): If p99 > 700ms or error spikes with OOMs, fallback immediately and tag as high risk for renewal conversation.
RunBot: Dry-run job created: id run-1876543211-sable, dryrun window 08:45-09:30 PT, owner Nate.
Nate (Solutions Eng): ACK. I'll upload the run results summary and attach the perf dashboard link into the runbook.
Sam (Infra): ACK. I'll enable autoscale shadow policy and ensure logs route to the shared S3 bucket.
Leah (CSM): ACK. I'll coordinate the customer invite and follow-up survey. Also scheduling a 20m debrief at 09:40 PT to capture notes and renewal risk signals.
Priya (Oncall): ACK. I'll be available for bridge.
Leah (CSM): Thanks team — final checklist for customer note: quota=150, dry-run=08:45-09:30, canary=08:50, quant test=int8, post-run survey link, debrief=09:40. Please react with :thumbsup: when ready.
